summary: Combine admin debug: "show results dialog" button to preview the end-of-run screen without playing a full run.
Combine DetailCard: + separator sits between chips (not inside the left chip), and recipe-chip pictograms show their tier swatch again.
Combine end screen: "New discoveries" tiles now use an inline pill (pictogram + label on one row, tier-coloured mini-tile) instead of pictogram-above-label.
Unify Combine recipe/discoveries chip into one .cbchip primitive with size + flavor modifiers (sm/xs, ghost/muted). Five parallel .cbrcp CSS blocks collapsed.
Combine: age-up now only counts unique first-finds at the current band (T-0051). Soft leaderboard reset at fix date — no backfill of historical Combine `progress` rows.
Combine DetailCard: show the item's kind as a pill under the name (matches item-page style). Only shown for known items.
Combine ages sheet: past ages now show `Done (X/Y)` with the band finds count vs threshold (T-0054).

Combine theme dialog: restart now names the mode × theme explicitly ("Restart Fast · Everyday") and honours Fast (previously silently switched to Endless). Side: subtext in theme dialog shrunk to 11px. (T-0046)
Introduce ButtonGroup component + migrate all action-button rows across Combine, Craft, 404, and shared dialogs. Fixes flush-button misclicks and prevents the pattern from recurring.
Combine move helper uses drag + highlight/tick/cross, matching the main board gesture
Combine audio resumes reliably after tab switch; music + SFX now on by default
Combine Fast mode: allow ≤ 3-part recipes (was pair-only), stop leaking Fast crafts into the lifetime collection, split Fast bests out in the stats panel. (T-0028)

Audited Combine game-state persistence: refresh resume works as designed; in-progress state is localStorage-only; result write trusts clamped client totals (cheatable before public leaderboard ships).
User feedback surface + admin triage (suggest item/recipe, report broken recipe)
Combine DetailCard: "Report this item" entry points the item at the feedback triage queue
Feedback dialog no longer shows raw ids / context block to the user (payload still carries them for admin)
Combine recipe toast: output chip shows pictogram; chip text readable in dark mode (T-0060)
Combine: feedback entry in More menu, DetailCard Report grouped with Back, human-readable "Reporting …" line in dialog
Combine: shared CombineTile primitive replaces duplicated tile JSX in Tray/Hold/Shelf/CollectionBook (T-0006)
CI: stub DATABASE_URL for `next build` prerender
Docker: stub DATABASE_URL in build stage so /_not-found prerender succeeds
Combine Move helper gains tap-to-select + preview (parity with tray)
Combine: tap-to-promote for 1-input recipes (star → supernova chain + heavy elements)
Combine: distinct lifetime-unlock toast, unlock SFX, and persistent ★ badge on shelf tiles
Combine Hold zone scrolls horizontally when held tiles overflow its width (T-0071).
Combine shelf/hold slots hold 30x30 aspect instead of squishing when overflowing (T-0072).
Combine: long-pressing a tile on mobile no longer selects page text
Combine: "Close call!" now fires only on a genuine rescue (board was full; combine freed cells).
Combine tracks per-recipe mastery; DetailCard shows "Mastered"/n-of-m pill and per-row made/unmade state; preview `+N` now counts only known alternatives
Combine collection book surfaces mastery (◆ and n/m badges) and new-unlock ★ with tap-to-acknowledge; fixes muted-chip pictogram contrast in dark mode and redesigns the signed-out CTA
Combine themes now support a per-theme dailyConfig (max ages, ageNeed scale, guest-ingredient pool). Admin UI on the per-theme page. Gameplay wiring pending.
Combine daily now builds a parallel bundle from combine_themes.dailyConfig. Age cap and ageNeedScale take effect on the next page load; endless mode is unchanged.
Daily measurement harness landed (measureDailyLength). Auto-player still stalls; tuning sweep deferred to T-0085.
Combine reactions: thumbs-up/down/flag on DiscoveryToast (recipe) and DetailCard (item or specific recipe via target picker); polymorphic reactions table serves both
DetailCard: replace green MASTERED pill with corner ◆ badge, matching CollectionBook
Combine Ages dialog: cap height, make age list scroll internally with bottom-fade "more below" hint
Combine daily schedule precomputed per (theme, day) with rotation memory + weighted sampling. Admin can review and regenerate 30 days; nightly Railway cron extends.
pm UI renders markdown again — restored vendored marked + DOMPurify + help-modal, added missing /vendor/help-modal.js route
Combine daily is a first-class mode. Dedicated /admin/combine/daily page; daily config moved to a singleton row. Regenerate protects today; schedule view shows served history.
Dev sign-in bypass no longer triggers Resend emails when RESEND_API_KEY is set locally
Footer Feedback button now styled like other links and no longer overflows on mobile game pages (T-0092)
Combine fast mode now populates the on-board History tray and DetailCard "how you made it" (T-0093)
Combine DetailCard: "Full story in Explore" and "Back to the game" now sit side-by-side in a ButtonGroup
Combine fast runs persist across refresh (own localStorage slot) (T-0094)
Combine fast mode: collection book + game-over summary no longer merge run-local finds into the lifetime figures
React error boundaries across the app: root + global-error + per-segment error.tsx for combine/craft/link/account/admin/i/[slug]/explore/[slug], plus a client ErrorBoundary around the Combine board
Endless & fast Combine shares now render a rich OG preview with score, unlocks, and mode/theme (T-0099)
/combine lands on today's daily when unfinished and no run is in flight (T-0097)
Retire styled-jsx from the 3 remaining sites (and 1 plain <style> tag); rules folded into globals.css (T-0102)
Simplify /pricing to Free + Supporter + Sponsor; add Combine; archive old educator-heavy copy to private _pricing-archive.

Combine daily is now a target-list run: ends on N unique discoveries (win) or board-full (loss); leaderboard sorts by (found DESC, turns ASC, score DESC). Admin configures N globally with optional per-weekday overrides.
Hide Link and Craft from public site (routes 404, nav/sitemap/robots stripped); code preserved — see docs/REVIVING-LINK-CRAFT.md.
Pricing: Patron tier replaces Supporter; platform-wide framing, upstream trace moved to Free, early KB access + extra Combine collections as headline Patron perks.
Public /leaderboard page shows today's Combine Daily plus the past 6 days. Signed-in users see their own row highlighted with a "You" badge. Structured for future games via a top-level game selector.
Add in-page "Report a mistake" entry points on About, Method, /i/[slug], and /explore/[slug] (feedback flow was already app-wide via footer; this just makes it visible)

/admin/combine/daily: reorganised sections (Daily length first, Daily shape second, ageNeedScale demoted to advanced details). Added Danger zone with Reset today's daily button for prod admin use — rate-limited, server-side day-key confirm, optional wipe of today's player results.
Header shows an Admin link for admin sessions; others still reach it via Account.
SFX packs for Combine: Classic / Wood / Chime / Off, picked from a pictogram-tile grid alongside the music tracks
Dedicated homepage at / with animated branching tree hero (chocolate/pancake/lemonade cycle), replaces the pass-through to Combine (T-0116)
Combine audio: music-bus ducking under sfx, chain-aware fuse with velocity/pitch ramp + verb open on big chains, weightier over with sub-strike

Combine daily can be feature-flagged off for non-admins via COMBINE_DAILY_ENABLED=0. Admins still see daily. Bundled with a stale-save fix: daily saves now stamp initialSeed so admin reset-today correctly invalidates mid-run saves.
Combine: compact header + tighter page chrome so the full board fits above the fold on first paint (mobile & common desktop)
Combine: game-shell UI — hide global site Header; Home + Account live in the game's More menu (supersedes T-0023)
Mobile nav: hamburger no longer disappears when a page's content exceeds viewport width (overflow-x:clip + wrap min-width:0)
combine-dailies-cron: switch image from curlimages/curl to alpine so the sh -c wrapper actually runs (endpoint was never hit since 2026-11-05)
PostHog instrumentation foundation (client + server SDKs, /ingest rewrite, typed track(), identify on login, environment super-property). No custom events yet.
Home hero animation now plays a 6-stage big-bang → smartphone chain in a fixed-size container
Admin landing tools grouped into Content / Combine / Media / Ops cards with blurbs; overview stats now a responsive card grid.
Audited Combine dealer/sampling/saves: daily goal is wired but likely unconfigured; endless pacing hurt by thin band-1 + RECENT_TRAY_WINDOW=2; save-loss needs repro logging.
Combine's between-session "new age has emerged" banner is now a tap-to-dismiss toast instead of a sticky strip above the board.
Admin tool for app-wide banners: /admin/banners authoring + publish/unpublish single-live slot, audience + severity + optional time window + per-banner dismissibility; renders above page chrome.
combine-dailies-cron: switch to curlimages/curl image, drop runtime apk, guard empty WEB_URL
admin item page: Incoming now resolves recipe-scoped links to their owning item (T-0150)
admin/items/[id]: contain overflowing inputs, drop btn container, add section helper text (T-0151)
KB: author plant/pig origins + promote combine-exclude tag to first-class column + mechanical guardrails (every item must chain to big bang).
Remove dead combine-everyday + fab-chain tags from seed data, Tag union, bulk-upload template, and admin UI; delete one-shot backfill-tags script
KB invariant audit on every admin mutation + bulk upload; 422 with offender list when a change would orphan an item or create a dead-end raw
Shipped T-0153 plant-origins migration to prod: pig + 13 band-1 plants now chain upstream to mammals / land plants (recipe inserts were a one-shot script never run until now).
Out-of-band DB writes (e.g. migrate-plant-origins) don't invalidate the in-process live snapshot; a service restart is required until LISTEN/NOTIFY is wired (src/graph/live.ts:7-8).

Theme builder: two-pane member/candidate editor with live validator at /admin/combine/themes/[code]; validator now matches Combine runtime (f/w/n/e parts, playable-recipe filter) via shared src/combine/parts.
Combine theme auto-chain: configurable stop rules (stopAtTiers/Tags, followLinkTypes, maxDepth) in /admin/combine/themes/[code], live full-theme preview, confirm modal on large expansions.
Combine theme builder follow-up: validator mirrors runtime dealt-base rule, stopAtKinds in closure config, manual/auto member source split with promote action, mobile-responsive layout.

Combine mode+theme picker: publish-gated themes with per-theme pictograms, horizontal-scroll tile picker (SoundMenu pattern), URL-driven selection (/combine?t=X&m=fast), CombineBoard fully decoupled from 'everything' hardcode.
combine: refresh now resumes the last-active mode instead of hardcoded fast>endless>daily priority
Delightful refresh toast appears when a new app version is deployed (holds back on /combine)
Admin → Debug: button to test-fire the update-available toast without a deploy
Combine top-bar: stack "best" under score on small screens, shrink score font (T-0179)
Combine top-bar: larger primary score on small screens, tighter gap to "best" (T-0179)
combine: server-authoritative run state behind COMBINE_SERVER_RUNS flag — closes client-forge-scores exploit
Replace all native window.confirm() dialogs with styled ConfirmDialog via useConfirm hook
Combine: honour ?t= theme selection over stale lastMode=daily/fast on mount
combine: shrink Helpers/More dialog rows on mobile so they fit without scrolling (T-0198)
combine: client reconciles server state on /checkpoint 409 (event-count, engine-version, run-ended)
combine: guided tutorial mode (scripted deck, per-user seen flag, dismissible landing nudge)
combine tutorial: switch to @reactour/tour spotlight + anchored popover (visible on mobile, styled to match ink-border aesthetic)
combine tutorial: replace @reactour/tour with native amber-glow spotlight overlay (fixes drop-swallowing + scroll pathology, removes 6 deps + 18 audit warnings)
combine: tutorial discoverable via mode picker (Learn card) + renamed More menu entry to "Replay tutorial"
combine tutorial: step copy now names the actual output the player made; FSM cascades through multi-event batches; step 4 highlights the tray
combine: top-bar mode chip reads "Tutorial" (amber, open-book glyph) during a tutorial run instead of falling through to "Endless"
combine tutorial: deck swapped to rock+water (familiar), 3 visible steps (welcome/firstCombine/secondCombine), empty opening board in tutorial mode
Combine admin theme edits now invalidate all active runs on that theme (T-0209)
